legacy.interpretation: Reveal/highlight of a fixed view, not proof of a rotating or operational mechanism. No AC-specific _MA file is present; the _MA directory has PB, PH, PM, PS and ST families. Shared construction ACS3 remains a separate existing presentation contract.

concept_attempts.feedback: Retains asymmetric narrow tall column, two rounded lower chambers, coral/gold/slate family, circular upper optic and front grille. Accepted as an interpreted modelling guide; enlarged fasteners and cap details are not recovered original geometry.

glb_feedback.observation: Original candidate hid most of the front gold roof and the service plates inside the casing.
glb_feedback.action: Re-seated visible service plates and rebuilt the chamber/cap join; added sparse maintenance details and restrained material wear.

glb_feedback.observation: The first cap adjustment left intersecting exposed lobes around the casing.
glb_feedback.action: Closed the lower chamber at its shoulder and seated a continuous separate onion cap, removing the protruding coral upper shell.

glb_feedback.observation: Actual independent-import front-quarter, front and rear views retain the required asymmetric silhouette, stepped column and rounded twin chambers. Real native/import pixel feedback also isolated a shadow-terminator representation mismatch.
glb_feedback.action: Explicit split normals with smooth face representation preserve the intended sharp edges and achieve pixel agreement without loosening tolerance.

review: Legacy-based remaster ready for integration review; no measured 80-percent score or exact hidden geometry claimed. Concept finish is interpreted and restrained for game cost. High-detail artistic acceptance remains with the user.
